# Temml (vendored)

TeX → MathML renderer for Wikipedia formulas, loaded by `/scripts/math.js` only on pages
that contain maths.

- Version: temml 0.13.5 (https://temml.org, https://github.com/ronkok/Temml), MIT licence (`LICENSE`)
- `temml.min.js`, `Temml-Local.css`, `Temml.woff2`: from `dist/`
- `texvc.js`: from `contrib/texvc/`, MediaWiki's texvc macros

To update, copy the same files from the new release and bump the version here.
